description: Regionalised heat demand and power-to-heat capacities is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Thermal demand > Germany: Regionalised heat demand and power-to-heat capacities (by DLR)", published or maintained by doi.org (publisher inferred from the link). region4FLEX model, data of first working package on zenodo: Regionalised heat demand and power-to-heat capacities METADATA Sector: Residential Buildings – Space Heating and Domestic Hot Water; Geographical scope: Germany; Geographical resolution: Administrative districts (NUTS-3); Temporal scope: 2011, three scenarios for 2030; Temporal resolution: 15min, Technologies: Single-storey heating, centr. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Thermal demand" lists it under "Germany: Regionalised heat demand and power-to-heat capacities (by DLR)". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support thermal (heat) demand inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
